keywords: community para sa mga young pro
q: Is this a community or group for young professionals?
What is the Young Pro Ministry?
Grupo ba ito para sa mga young professionals?
Komunidad ba ito ng mga young pro?
Para kanino ba ang Young Pro Ministry?
a_en: Yes — we're a community of Filipino young professionals chasing Jesus and our callings at the same time. FTB Young Pro Ministry is the young professionals' department of Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc., here so you don't have to do faith, work, and friendship alone.
a_tl: Oo — isa kaming komunidad ng mga Pinoy young professionals na sabay na hinahabol si Jesus at ang aming mga calling. Ang FTB Young Pro Ministry ang young professionals' department ng Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc., para hindi mo kailangang harapin nang mag-isa ang faith, trabaho, at pakikipagkaibigan.

q: Is there a Christian fellowship for professionals in Quezon City?
Christian community for young professionals in Novaliches?
May Christian fellowship ba para sa professionals sa Quezon City?
May fellowship ba kayo na malapit sa Novaliches?
Saan may Christian community for young pros sa QC?
a_en: Yes — we're a Christian fellowship for young professionals based in Novaliches, Quezon City. We meet at FTB Auditorium, #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. Everyone's welcome — come as you are.
a_tl: Oo — isa kaming Christian fellowship para sa mga young professionals dito sa Novaliches, Quezon City. Nagtitipon kami sa FTB Auditorium, #206 P. Orbe St., Blueville Subdivision, Novaliches, Quezon City. Welcome ang lahat — halika lang, kahit ano pang pinagdadaanan mo.

keywords: where can young pros find community
q: Where can young pros find community and faith friends?
Where can I find a Christian barkada?
Saan makakahanap ng barkada at faith friends ang mga young pro?
Pwede ba akong makahanap ng Christian friends dito?
Nahihirapan akong magkaroon ng godly friends — may matutulungan ba ako?
a_en: Right here. A big part of what we do is help strangers become barkada and barkada become a faith group — through fellowships, coffee, and our monthly hangouts. If you've been looking for real, God-honoring friendships, you're welcome to join us.
a_tl: Dito mismo. Malaking bahagi ng ginagawa namin ay tulungan ang mga estranghero na maging barkada, at ang barkada na maging faith group — sa pamamagitan ng fellowships, kape, at monthly hangouts. Kung naghahanap ka ng totoo at God-honoring na pagkakaibigan, welcome ka sa amin.

q: Is this about networking and faith for professionals?
Do you mix career and faith?
Networking ba ito para sa mga professionals na may faith?
Pinagsasama ba ninyo ang career at faith?
May connection ba ito sa trabaho at pananampalataya?
a_en: Our heart is faith and excellence lived out in the marketplace — chasing Jesus and your calling at the same time. You'll meet fellow young pros across many fields, but more than networking, we're after real friendship and growing together in faith. (Our anchor verse is Proverbs 16:3.)
a_tl: Ang puso namin ay faith at excellence na isinasabuhay sa marketplace — sabay na hinahabol si Jesus at ang calling mo. Makakasalamuha mo ang mga kapwa young pro mula sa iba't ibang larangan, pero higit pa sa networking, hinahanap namin ang totoong pagkakaibigan at sabay na paglago sa faith. (Ang anchor verse namin ay Proverbs 16:3.)

q: Who can join the Young Pro Ministry?
Can I join even if I'm not a member of the church?
Sino ba ang pwedeng sumali?
Pwede ba ako kahit fresh grad pa lang ako?
Pwede ba kahit first time ko pa lang?
a_en: If you're a young professional (or a fresh grad finding your footing) who wants faith, friendship, and growth, you're welcome — whether or not you're already part of the church. No requirements, just come as you are. Bring a friend, too!
a_tl: Kung young professional ka (o fresh grad na naghahanap pa ng direksyon) na gustong magkaroon ng faith, friendship, at growth, welcome ka — member ka man ng church o hindi pa. Walang requirements, halika lang kung ano ka man ngayon. Magdala ka rin ng kaibigan!

q: What makes this community different?
Why should I join your fellowship over others?
Ano ang kaibahan ninyo sa ibang community?
Bakit kayo ang dapat kong piliin?
Ano ang ibig sabihin ng mga themes ninyo?
a_en: We disciple in a way that's deeply Filipino — built around values like Loob, Kapwa, Malasakit, Bahala Na, and Utang na Loob, redeemed through a Christian lens. So faith here doesn't feel imported; it feels like home, in a community that gets the young-pro life.
a_tl: Nagdidisciple kami sa paraang totoong Pinoy — nakabatay sa mga values gaya ng Loob, Kapwa, Malasakit, Bahala Na, at Utang na Loob, na tinitingnan sa Christian lens. Kaya ang faith dito, hindi parang hiram; parang tahanan, sa isang community na gets ang buhay ng young pro.

q: How do you usually meet and what do you do?
What kind of activities do you have?
Paano kayo nagtitipon at ano ang ginagawa ninyo?
Ano-ano ang mga activities ninyo?
May outings ba kayo?
a_en: Two ways: our YP Fellowship (worship, the Word, a topic, and sharing — usually 2:30 PM on the 2nd or 3rd week of the month) and our monthly YPGT (Young Pro Get-Together) outings like coffee, swimming, museum tours, and hobby/fitness hangouts. Faith and friendship, inside and outside the four walls.
a_tl: Dalawa ang paraan: ang YP Fellowship namin (worship, ang Word, isang topic, at sharing — kadalasan 2:30 PM tuwing 2nd o 3rd week ng buwan) at ang monthly YPGT (Young Pro Get-Together) na outings gaya ng kape, swimming, museum tours, at hobby/fitness hangouts. Faith at friendship, sa loob at labas ng simbahan.

q: How do I join or get in touch?
Where can I message you?
Paano ako sasali o makakapag-message?
Saan ko kayo makokontak?
Pwede ba akong mag-sign up?
a_en: Easy — just come to a fellowship or message us anytime at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and we'll welcome you in. You can also tap Join Us on the site to connect.
a_tl: Madali lang — pumunta ka lang sa isang fellowship o mag-message ka sa amin anytime sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at malugod ka naming tatanggapin. Pwede mo ring i-tap ang Join Us dito sa site para makakonek.

q: Is it free, and is it a safe space to come as I am?
Will I be judged if I'm still figuring out my faith?
Libre ba ito at okay lang bang dumalo kahit ano ang pinagdadaanan ko?
May bayad ba para sumali?
Hindi ba ako jujudge-an kung struggling pa ako?
a_en: It's free, and it's a warm, no-judgment space — come exactly as you are, wherever you are with God or your career. No pressure, just real people and real kwentuhan. If you're nervous, message us first at ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com and someone will meet you.
a_tl: Libre ito, at isang mainit at walang panghuhusgang lugar — halika kung ano ka man, kahit saan ka pa sa pakikipag-ugnayan mo sa Diyos o sa career mo. Walang pressure, totoong tao at totoong kwentuhan lang. Kung kinakabahan ka, mag-message ka muna sa ftb.youngpro.ministry@gmail.com at may sasalubong sa iyo.

q: What church is this connected to?
Is the Young Pro Ministry part of a church?
Anong simbahan ang konektado dito?
Kabahagi ba ito ng isang church?
Ano ang FTB?
a_en: We're the Young Pro Ministry (the young professionals' department) of Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. (FTB) in Novaliches, Quezon City. Our heartbeat follows the church's purpose: Worship God. Make Disciples.
a_tl: Kami ang Young Pro Ministry (ang young professionals' department) ng Faith Temple Baptist Church Inc. (FTB) dito sa Novaliches, Quezon City. Ang tibok ng puso namin ay sumusunod sa purpose ng church: Worship God. Make Disciples.
